source_refs.note: Exercise 3.5, Question 2 (i)-(iii): piecewise and absolute-value integrals; book p. 101. Key on p. 300 under 'Exercise 3.2'; (iii) is labelled a second '(ii)'.

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Evaluate the following definite integral: \(\int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,dx\), where \(f(x) = \begin{cases} 5 - 3x & \text{if } x \leq 0 \\ 5 + 3x & \text{if } x > 0 \end{cases}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh piecewise function hai: 0 se pehle ek formula chalta hai aur 0 ke baad doosra.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x)\) ke do hisse aur limits \(-1\) se \(1\).
Find kya karna hai? Poore interval par integral.
Rule kaunsa? Property III: jahan formula badalta hai (yahan \(x = 0\)), wahan interval ko tor dete hain aur har hisse par us ka apna formula lagate hain.
Plan: \(x = 0\) par torna, dono hisse integrate, jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x \leq 0\) ke liye \(f(x) = 5 - 3x\), aur \(x > 0\) ke liye \(f(x) = 5 + 3x\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property III \(\int_a^b f = \int_a^c f + \int_c^b f\), jahan \(c = 0\) woh point hai jahan formula badalta hai. Ek hi formula poore interval par lagana ghalat hoga.

\(x = 0\) par interval torein
\[\int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,dx = \int_{-1}^{0} (5 - 3x)\,dx\]
\[+ \int_{0}^{1} (5 + 3x)\,dx\]
Kyun: \([-1, 0]\) par pehla rule lagta hai aur \((0, 1]\) par doosra. Akele ek point (yahan \(x = 0\)) se integral ki value par koi farq nahi parta, is liye 0 kis hisse mein gaya, yeh masla nahi.

Left hissa
\[\left[5x - \dfrac{3x^2}{2}\right]_{-1}^{0} = 0 - \left(-5 - \dfrac{3}{2}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{13}{2}\]
Kyun: \(x = 0\) par value 0; \(x = -1\) par \(5(-1) - \frac{3}{2}(-1)^2 = -5 - \frac{3}{2} = -\frac{13}{2}\). Negative ko minus karne se plus ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: \((-1)^2 = 1\) hai, is liye \(-\frac{3x^2}{2}\) ki value \(-\frac{3}{2}\) hi rehti hai.

Right hissa
\[\left[5x + \dfrac{3x^2}{2}\right]_{0}^{1} = 5 + \dfrac{3}{2} = \dfrac{13}{2}\]
Kyun: power rule; \(x = 0\) par value zero hai.

Jama karein
\[\int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,dx = \dfrac{13}{2} + \dfrac{13}{2} = 13\]
Kyun: Property III ke mutabiq dono hisson ka jama poora integral hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-x) = 5 + 3x = f(x)\ \ (x > 0)\]
Kyun: ghaur karein to \(f(x) = 5 + 3|x|\) hai, yani even function, jis ka graph V ki shakal ka hai aur y-axis ke dono taraf bilkul ek jaisa. Is liye dono hisse barabar aane chahiye the, aur aaye. Answer key mein bhi 13 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Evaluate the following definite integral: \(\int_{-3}^{5} f(x)\,dx\), where \(f(x) = |x - 4| + |x|\)
blocks.explanation:
Is function mein do absolute values ka jama hai. Absolute value ka formula wahan badalta hai jahan andar wali cheez zero ho.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = |x - 4| + |x|\) aur limits \(-3\) se \(5\).
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki value.
Rule kaunsa? Corner points \(x = 4\) aur \(x = 0\) hain. In par interval ko teen hisson mein torenge (Property III), har hisse mein bars hata kar seedha formula likhenge, bilkul Example 50 ki tarah.
Plan: corner points, teen formulas, teen integrals, jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: \([-3, 5]\) par \(f(x) = |x - 4| + |x|\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-3}^{5} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(|u| = u\) jab \(u \geq 0\), aur \(|u| = -u\) jab \(u < 0\). \(x - 4\) aur \(x\) ke zero points par interval toreinge (Property III). Bars ke saath seedha integrate nahi hota, is liye pehle bars hatana zaroori hai.

Har hisse mein bars hatayein
\[[-3, 0]:\ f = (4 - x) + (-x) = 4 - 2x\]
\[[0, 4]:\ f = (4 - x) + x = 4\]
\[[4, 5]:\ f = (x - 4) + x = 2x - 4\]
Kyun: \(x < 4\) ho to \(x - 4\) negative hai, to \(|x - 4| = 4 - x\). \(x < 0\) ho to \(|x| = -x\). Har hisse mein dono ka sign dekh kar formula banaya. Beech wale hisse mein \(x\) cancel ho gaya aur sirf 4 bacha.
Dhyan dein: \(|x - 4|\) ko \(x + 4\) ya \(-x - 4\) likhna aam ghalti hai; poori bracket ka sign badalta hai: \(-(x - 4) = 4 - x\).

Doosra hissa
\[\int_{0}^{4} 4\,dx = \Big[4x\Big]_{0}^{4} = 16\]
Kyun: constant ka integral constant times lambai; graph mein yeh \(4 \times 4\) ka rectangle hai.

Teesra hissa
\[\int_{4}^{5} (2x - 4)\,dx = \Big[x^2 - 4x\Big]_{4}^{5}\]
\[= (25 - 20) - (16 - 16) = 5\]
Kyun: power rule se antiderivative, phir limits.

Jama karein
\[\int_{-3}^{5} f(x)\,dx = 21 + 16 + 5 = 42\]
Kyun: Property III se teeno hisson ka jama poora integral hai.

Tasdeeq: triangles se
\[\int_{-3}^{5} |x - 4|\,dx = \tfrac{1}{2}(7)(7) + \tfrac{1}{2}(1)(1) = 25\]
\[\int_{-3}^{5} |x|\,dx = \tfrac{1}{2}(3)(3) + \tfrac{1}{2}(5)(5) = 17\]
Kyun: har absolute value ka graph V ki shakal ka hai jo do triangles banata hai; area \(\frac{1}{2} \times\) base \(\times\) height. \(25 + 17 = 42\), bilkul wohi jawab. Answer key mein bhi 42 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Evaluate the following definite integral: \(\int_{-3}^{4} |4 - x^2|\,dx\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(4 - x^2\) ki absolute value hai. \(4 - x^2\) ka sign \(x = -2\) aur \(x = 2\) par badalta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(|4 - x^2|\) aur limits \(-3\) se \(4\).
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki value.
Rule kaunsa? \([-2, 2]\) par \(4 - x^2\) positive hai, bahar negative. Is liye interval \([-3, 4]\) ko \(-2\) aur \(2\) par toreinge aur har hisse mein bars hata kar integrate karenge.
Plan: zero points, teen formulas, teen integrals, jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{-3}^{4} |4 - x^2|\,dx\).
Maloom karna: is ki value.
Tareeqa: pehle dekhein \(4 - x^2 = 0\) kab hota hai: \(x = \pm 2\). Phir har hisse mein bars hatayein aur Property III se jama karein.

Bars hatayein
\[[-3, -2]:\ |4 - x^2| = x^2 - 4\]
\[[-2, 2]:\ |4 - x^2| = 4 - x^2\]
\[[2, 4]:\ |4 - x^2| = x^2 - 4\]
Kyun: \(x^2 \leq 4\) tabhi hota hai jab \(-2 \leq x \leq 2\); wahan andar wali cheez positive hai, to bars waise hi hat jati hain. Bahar \(x^2 > 4\), to andar wali cheez negative hai aur us ka ulta \(x^2 - 4\) lena parta hai. Ek misaal se dekhein: \(x = 3\) par \(4 - 9 = -5\), aur \(|{-5}| = 5 = 9 - 4\).

Pehla hissa
\[\left[\dfrac{x^3}{3} - 4x\right]_{-3}^{-2} = \left(-\dfrac{8}{3} + 8\right) - (-9 + 12)\]
\[= \dfrac{16}{3} - 3 = \dfrac{7}{3}\]
Kyun: \((-2)^3 = -8\) aur \((-3)^3 = -27\), \(\frac{-27}{3} = -9\); \(-4(-3) = 12\).
Dhyan dein: negative numbers ke cube negative hote hain; yahan signs mein sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain.

Beech wala hissa
\[\left[4x - \dfrac{x^3}{3}\right]_{-2}^{2} = \left(8 - \dfrac{8}{3}\right) - \left(-8 + \dfrac{8}{3}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{16}{3} + \dfrac{16}{3} = \dfrac{32}{3}\]
Kyun: power rule. Integrand even hai, is liye yeh \([0, 2]\) wale hisse \(\frac{16}{3}\) ka do guna aaya.

Aakhri hissa
\[\left[\dfrac{x^3}{3} - 4x\right]_{2}^{4} = \left(\dfrac{64}{3} - 16\right) - \left(\dfrac{8}{3} - 8\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{16}{3} + \dfrac{16}{3} = \dfrac{32}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{64}{3} - 16 = \frac{16}{3}\) aur \(\frac{8}{3} - 8 = -\frac{16}{3}\); negative ko minus kiya to plus.

Jama karein
\[\dfrac{7}{3} + \dfrac{32}{3} + \dfrac{32}{3} = \dfrac{71}{3}\]
Kyun: Property III.

Tasdeeq
\[\int_{-3}^{4} (4 - x^2)\,dx = -\dfrac{7}{3}\]
\[-\dfrac{7}{3} + 2\left(\dfrac{7}{3} + \dfrac{32}{3}\right) = \dfrac{71}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: bars ke baghair integral mein bahar wale do hisse negative gine jate hain (\(-\frac{7}{3}\) aur \(-\frac{32}{3}\)). Unhein do dafa wapas jama karein to woh positive ho jate hain, aur wohi \(\frac{71}{3}\) aata hai. Answer key mein bhi \(\frac{71}{3}\) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is jawab par dobara '(ii)' likha hai (2. (i) 13, (ii) 42, (ii) \(\frac{71}{3}\)). Teesra jawab asal mein part (iii) ka hai, aur us ki value \(\frac{71}{3}\) bilkul sahi hai; sirf label ghalat chhapa hai.
